<슥9:9> 시온의 딸아 크게 기뻐할지어다 예루살렘의 딸아 즐거이 부를지:
<Zech 9:9> Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
 - Because Jesus came like this, the proud were judged automatically.
 - And it also says that a day will come when Jerusalem is blessed once more, in the last days.
<슥13:7> 만군의 여호와가 말하노라 칼아 깨어서 내 목자, 내 짝된:
<Zech 13:7> Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

6. 예수님의 재림장면: 6. The scene of Jesus' second coming
<슥14:1~3> 여호와의 날이 이르리라 그 날에 네 재물이 약탈되어 너:
<Zech 14:1~3> Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee. For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city. Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
 - A certain day is coming, a day when the nations fight against Jerusalem.
지금 유대인들이 너무 악하게 하는데 언젠가는 수많은 나라가 유대인들이 뒤: Right now the Jews are acting really wickedly, and someday many nations will realize that the Jews are pulling the strings behind the scenes, and the nations will all gather to fight against the Jews.
It's the final war that we saw in Ezekiel chapters 38~39 breaking out.
<슥14:4~5> 그 날에 그의 발이 예루살렘 앞 곧 동편 감람 산에 서:
<Zech 14:4~5> And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south. And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
 - Because it says the feet of Jesus at His second coming will stand on the Mount of Olives, people have made lots of graves on the Mount of Olives.
And at that time all the holy ones who have fallen asleep in the Lord will rise again and come with Him.
 - In Amos, "two years before the earthquake"... -> there was an earthquake big enough to become a byword. This is that byword.
<슥14:12> 예루살렘을 친 모든 백성에게 여호와께서 내리실 재앙이 이:
<Zech 14:12> And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
 - Zechariah also saw a picture of some war in the last days: the wicked people who tried to attack Jerusalem were standing there, and their flesh rotted, their eyes rotted, their tongues rotted. It was a scene that brings chemical and biological warfare to mind.
<슥14:20> 그 날에는 말 방울에까지 여호와께 성결이라 기록될 것이라:
<Zech 14:20> In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
 - It also tells us that a day will come when even the bells of the horses say HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD, and everyone worships Him.
 - If you know this kind of information, then as you watch what happens from here on, you can get some idea. Of how far along we are toward the end of history...
